svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four layers, 189 mm in all, 1,208 mm across (the inside of the jacket).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Boards: two layers of 50 mm stone wool board, each from two 610 x 1,219 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: boards butted into a 1,219 mm square and cut to a 1,208 mm disc.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Turn the top layer 90 degrees so the joints cross.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Firebrick: one course laid flat (64 mm), 610 mm disc in the middle,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bricks in staggered rows, cut with a saw to the circle (layout picture).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: AES board: one 25 mm board cut to a 610 mm disc, laid on the bricks.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ring: 89 mm stone wool batt cut into segments to fill from the 610 mm disc

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: out to 1,208 mm, level with the top of the AES board.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the drum's bottom rim (597 mm) stands on the AES disc, 6 mm in from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its edge, over the firebrick, which carries the load.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the top is flat within 3 mm across a straight edge.
